unresolvedReviewThreads.summary: **Low: Unbounded SSE buffering enables denial of service** An attacker controlling a custom upstream can send an unlimited sequence of chunks without a frame separator. This line retains the entire sequence and copies the growing buffer for every chunk, causing unbounded memory use and quadratic CPU work; `buffered_frames` in the router similarly retains unlimited pre-content frames such as pings.

**Stream failures lose accounting** When an HTTP-200 stream raises or emits an SSE error, this guard suppresses success logging without dispatching failure handlers, dropping spend and monitoring records
